title: Rogun dam reservoir
river: Vakhsh, a main source of the Amu Darya
headline: Open water shrank 86 % between 20 Jun and 30 Oct

sections.p: Open water shrank from 24.3 km² on 20 Jun to 3.4 km² on 30 Oct 2026 (-86 %). Biggest: 24.3 km² on 20 Jun; smallest: 1.0 km² on 31 Aug.
When the dam holds less, more of the Vakhsh flows on into the Amu Darya.

If the season's trend holds (-2.5 km² a month), the next 3 months would end near 0.0 km². This is a trend line, not a tested forecast: one season of NISAR is too short to learn this place's yearly cycle.
Amu darya users downstream: uzbekistan and turkmenistan. NISAR sees this water every 12 days through cloud and at night.

confidence: The model learned water at Andijan and was tested here on 3 clear photo days it never trained on: median IoU 0.02.
sources: NASA-ISRO NISAR GCOV (provisional before 21 Oct 2026); model trained on Andijan; ESA Sentinel-2 photo check.
